words.ex: Exercise benefits both body and mind.
A blast of wind blew the door open.
It is a convention to shake hands.
There is no need to hurry.
The match was held in the stadium.
The success was largely due to luck.

quiz.q: You are supposed to ______ the library books on time.
quiz.why: return the books 还书；be supposed to 应该。

tip.text: 虚拟语气（与现在相反）：If I were you, I would study harder. be 动词一律用 were。

listening.title: 长对话 1 · 选课
listening.q: What subject does the woman finally choose?
listening.script: I cannot decide which course to take this term. How about computer science? It is useful and the teacher is great. You are right, I will take it.

sentence.en: Exercise benefits both body and mind.
